The main takeaway from our work is that

the integrated disease management of white rust, Alternaria leaf blight and stem rot of rapeseed mustard through bioagents, plant products and fungitoxicants is an effective strategy for the management of these diseases.
the integrated management approach is more effective in managing diseases of rapeseed–mustard and it is more economical and environment friendly than the use of chemicals alone.
the use of integrated disease management practices can reduce the incidence of disease and improve the yield and economics of rapeseed mustard.
